title: WhatsApp Business Platform moves to per-message pricing in January
summary: Conversation-based pricing is retired; every template message will be billed individually. Businesses running automated follow-up sequences should review their volumes.

title: Deprecation notice: claude-opus-4-7 retires on 30 November
summary: Applications pinned to this model id should migrate. Requests after the retirement date will return an error.

title: Twilio changes how programmable voice handles call forwarding
summary: A new parameter controls fallback behaviour when the downstream leg does not answer.

title: Anthropic extends prompt caching to tool definitions
summary: Cached tool blocks are billed at a reduced rate, which lowers cost for long-running agent loops.

title: Supabase changes connection pooling defaults for serverless clients
summary: Projects using the transaction pooler will see different behaviour under concurrency.

title: Realtime voice API adds barge-in and configurable turn detection
summary: Useful for any AI receptionist answering a shop's phone where callers interrupt.

title: Messaging platform adds automatic re-engagement for dormant contacts
summary: The feature helps businesses where leads come in, sit there, and nobody ever gets back to them, and where they never go back to the people who already paid them.

title: Retell is being acquired and will sunset its current voice API
summary: Existing customers have ninety days to migrate to the acquirer's platform.
